lines: THE WORD MARVEL ISN'T ALLOWED TO PUT ON A COVER

segments.text: Marvel almost didn't happen. Its founder was two seats away from dying in 1937.
But he waits too long. Only two tickets left, and they're not together — three days apart from his own wife, crossing the Atlantic. No thanks.
May sixth, nineteen thirty-seven. The Hindenburg goes up in flames while landing in New Jersey. Thirty-six people don't walk away.
Two years later, Goodman hires his wife's seventeen-year-old cousin — Stanley Lieber. You know him as Stan Lee. One sold-out airship, and there's no Marvel at all.
